product_one_liner.value: Marquee unifies clubs’ internal and external football data and filters it through each club’s sporting DNA to deliver decision-ready insights for professional clubs’ recruitment, squad-planning and analytics teams.

pricing_page.notes: The visible navigation and footer contain no pricing link, and the attempted /pricing URL did not return a pricing page.

eng_blog.notes: The news index includes technical posts by the CTO on architecture and the Chief Data Scientist on the squad-fit model.

public_docs.notes: The homepage links to a single FAQ page, but no product documentation or developer portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The listing showed an active Senior AI Scientist posting updated November 3, 2026.

model_provider.notes: The official product, FAQ and technical/news materials reviewed describe proprietary models but do not name an AI model provider.

last_funding.notes: Contemporaneous reporting identifies a $4M seed round; Marquee’s July 30 announcement describes $6.5M as total funding raised.

raised_18mo.notes: Marquee announced its funding on July 30, 2026, within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable Marquee job board lists a Senior AI Scientist role, not an SDR, BDR or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: On July 14, 2026, Marquee announced that users could access SkillCorner data through its platform.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A dated company LinkedIn announcement says Yuval Foox joined as VP Data & AI in September 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable job posting does not name a CRM or sales/marketing system.
